nodes.label: Session-First Bearer-Fallback Auth Strategy
nodes.rationale: DynamicGuard tries session guards first, then falls back to bearer token auth. This allows SPAs with session cookies and API clients with tokens to share the same auth:dynamic middleware without splitting routes.

nodes.label: Automatic SHA256 Token Hashing
nodes.rationale: Token attribute mutator hashes on write so plaintext is never persisted. Lookup is via WHERE token = SHA256(secret) with a unique index. Prevents accidental plaintext storage.

nodes.label: Token Prefix and CRC32B Decoration
nodes.rationale: Tokens are decorated as {prefix}{random}{crc32b(random)}. The prefix enables secret scanning (e.g., GitHub); the CRC32B checksum catches truncation or corruption before hitting the database.

nodes.label: Per-User Token Limit Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Uses DB transaction + lockForUpdate to prevent TOCTOU races when enforcing maxTokensPerUser. Only wraps in transaction when a limit is configured to avoid overhead for unlimited mode.
